name: Sentinel Corp Biometric Integration Bodysuit
description:
A full-body base layer that serves as the integration platform for Sentinel Corp's employee monitoring system. The suit tracks location, vital signs, stress hormones, sleep patterns, and caloric expenditure, transmitting continuous data to Sentinel's workforce management system. Employees are required to wear it during all active shifts.

The suit is comfortable, well-made, and provided free of charge. It is also a total surveillance garment that gives the corponation real-time awareness of every employee's physical and emotional state. Refusal to wear it is grounds for contract termination.
functionality: Full biometric monitoring, GPS tracking, workforce analytics integration
what_it_says: Your employer owns your schedule, your location, and your biometric data, and you wear the proof against your skin.
story_hooks: A Sentinel employee's Integration Bodysuit shows 30 minutes of flatlined biometric data in the middle of a shift — but the employee was seen working normally during that window, suggesting someone spoofed the suit.
